videos.headline: Arkansas wins SEC tournament to end 26-year drought
videos.description: Darius Acuff Jr. pours in 30 points and 11 assists to lead Arkansas to its first SEC tournament title since 2000.

tracking.trackingName: COM_CBB Highlight (Arkansas wins SEC tournament to end 26-year drought) 2026/03/15 ESHEET

videos.headline: Highlight: Arkansas runs aways from Vandy, claims second SEC Championship
videos.description: Darius Acuff lives up to the hype, recording 30 points and 11 assists while Trevon Brazile puts away the 'Dores with 16 points on four threes as the Hogs claim the SEC title, 86-75.

videos.headline: Arkansas' John Calipari soaks in the moment with players, fans
videos.description: Following a resounding "Woo Pig Sooie!" chant, Calipari shows extreme gratitude for the Razorbacks fans in Bridgestone Arena and praises his team's talent and togetherness.

videos.headline: Meleek Thomas says Razorbacks' togetherness led to SEC Championship
videos.description: Thomas takes time to discuss what this championship means to him and his teammates while explaining how Arkansas has weathered all kinds of adversity ahead of the NCAA Tournament.

videos.headline: Arkansas' Maliq Ewin emphasizes significance of SEC Championship win
videos.description: Ewin describes the feeling of securing the SEC title over 4-seed Vanderbilt and credits the 3-seed Razorbacks' offensive weapons for their successful tournament run.
